concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-classic-platforms-onboard-users-custom-onboarding]] — 2020-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Classic custom account-holder onboarding guide for upfront/staggered collection, Account API v6 updates, notification-gated verification and asynchronous documents.
